caller_tactics.text: Hello, is this Eszter? This is Maria Lund from Halden Ridge Savings Bank. You asked us about certificates of deposit last month, so I'm calling to follow up.
It is. We have a one-year certificate offering a fixed rate. The current rate ends this Friday, the twenty-fourth, so if you're interested, there's time to think about it.
The minimum is one thousand dollars. You can choose any amount above that, and the money stays in the certificate for twelve months.
There's an early withdrawal charge, which is written in the account terms. I'll send you that document along with the rate sheet.
The rate on the sheet is fixed until the offer ends. After Friday, the bank may publish a new rate, which might be higher or lower.
Yes, deposits at Halden Ridge are insured by the government up to the legal limit per depositor. I'll include that in the information pack.
Of course. Take your time. You're welcome to talk it over with your family or your adviser first.
Either is fine. I'll email the rate sheet today, and I can post a paper copy as well if you prefer.
The branch number is on the letter we sent you. Please call whenever you're ready, and there's no obligation.
